errors.text_span: Die x-Achse stellt den Index dar, mit Werten von 1.000 bis 9.000
errors.evidence: The x-axis represents years (2016 to 2024), not an index with values from 1,000 to 9,000.
The left y-axis ranges from 0 to 1,000, and the right y-axis ranges from 0 to 9,000. The description incorrectly states the range as 0 to 900.

errors.text_span: und sinkt schließlich auf etwa 700 bis 2024

The description does not mention that the chart illustrates the development of indices for economic policy, financial policy, and trade policy over time.
The description omits the left y-axis label ('Index') and its range (0 to 1,000) and tick intervals (100).
The description omits the right y-axis label ('Index') and its range (0 to 9,000) and tick intervals (1,000).

The description does not mention the legend, which identifies the black line as 'Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt (linke Skala)', the blue line as 'Finanzpolitik (linke Skala)', and the purple line as 'Handelspolitik (rechte Skala)'.
The description does not mention the sharp increase in the purple line to approximately 8,000 by 2024.
